placements.why: The document introduces organizational directives mandating the total removal and intentional forgetting of historical technical and product records.
placements.title: Authoritative Control Over Record Retention and Deliberate Knowledge Purging
placements.frame: how does the organization govern the retention, deletion, and intentional erasure of historical decisions and technical architectures?

placements.title: Expunging Prior Architectural and Product Commitments From Institutional Memory
placements.frame: how and under what authority are past technical migrations and product decisions systematically deleted or suppressed from organizational knowledge?
placements.why: The directives mandate the deliberate forgetting of the Quantum Widget Decision and the total removal of all knowledge concerning the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration.
